Create one production concept image for the Career World skill building "Workflow orchestration". This is a compact supporting skill structure: highly detailed and distinctive, smaller than project landmarks and much smaller than city capitals. Research-grounded domain summary: A durable coordination capability that sequences dependent work, fans tasks out and back in, persists state transitions, schedules or triggers execution, applies retries and timeouts, routes exceptions, and exposes observable recovery points. Accepted baseline identity: A circular conductor rotunda with a tall central drum, six staggered low service bays, and one interrupted ring ramp that creates a readable radial silhouette.
